changelog:
- Initial release of the Content Ideas skill (free).
- Generates blog post ideas, social media topics, and content calendar suggestions based on your niche.
- Designed to help users overcome content blocks and plan editorial calendars.
- Offers examples and quick start prompts for easy use.
- Highlights upgrade path to Content Creator Suite for advanced features.
summary: Free content brainstorming tool. Generates blog post ideas, social media topics, and content calendar suggestions based on your niche. Use when you're stuck...
